thread:
maya: Heads-up: the dashboard embed example on Console embeds.md is failing in Chromium due to CSP. The iframe is blocked.
leo: Which CSP directive?
maya: The page includes `Content-Security-Policy: frame-src 'self'` but our embed demo needs frames from `embed.redwood.ai`. The live sample shows a blank iframe.
priya: Oh right, we updated the embed domain last quarter and docs didn't get the CSP note. Quick fix: add a note about adding `frame-src https://embed.redwood.ai; child-src https://embed.redwood.ai`. Also update the example to use the signed embed token flow.
security-bot: Alert: when documenting signed embeds, avoid publishing real secret keys. Use pseudo-code and the server-side HMAC pattern. Recommend showing an example that derives a short-lived token (expires in 2m).
leo: I'll open a PR to: 1) patch the CSP guidance, 2) replace the raw token example with a server sign snippet, 3) add a compact Node client iframe snippet that fetches the signed token.
maya: Please include the minimal Python server example and a note about verifying token expiry on the embed service. Keep snippets tiny (2-4 lines).
leo: Drafting snippets. Python (server):
```python
import hmac, hashlib, time
secret=b"YOUR_SECRET"
payload=f"user_id:alice,exp:{int(time.time())+120}"
sig=hmac.new(secret,payload.encode(),hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
signed_token=f"{payload}.{sig}"
```
Node (client iframe load):
```js
const t = await fetch('/signed-embed-token').then(r=>r.text());
const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
iframe.src = `https://embed.redwood.ai/dashboard?token=${encodeURIComponent(t)}`;
document.body.appendChild(iframe);
```
priya: Add a short paragraph about setting CSP headers in common hosts: Netlify, Vercel, nginx example and a note to use `frame-ancestors` for modern browsers. Also add an accessibility alt text for the embedded preview screenshot.
leo: Good call. I'll add an nginx snippet: `add_header Content-Security-Policy "frame-ancestors 'self' https://embed.redwood.ai";` and mention the broader `connect-src` for websocket telemetry endpoints.
docs-bot: lint/links-checker started for PR #10321 by leo
security-bot: Quick security review: ensure snippet warns about clock skew and token replay; recommend short ttl and nonce if possible.
maya: Keep the docs change minimal: (A) CSP note, (B) replace pasted secret with pseudo-code, (C) add Node client snippet, (D) add `#embed-token` migration anchor and changelog line. We'll iterate on full embed guide later.
leo: Done: added `#embed-token` anchor, changelog entry, the Python/Node snippets, nginx example, alt text `Embedded dashboard preview showing top models by cost`. CI: running.
